nodes.title: fix(scaffold/service): generated services have no internal layering — the v1 router template teaches ORM-in-handler and `deno task test` fails on an empty tree
docs(orchestration-runtime): outbound webhook delivery has no recipe or template — triggers ship inbound ingress only, so every product hand-rolls signing, retry and dead-lettering
fix(plugins): every declareHealthChecks returns only the API resource — a crash-looping background child leaves the declared health surface green
fix(streams): STREAMS_DATA_DIR is set by nothing the framework generates, so "durable streams" is always in-memory
fix(plugins): two defects shipped as documented caveats — WORKER_CONCURRENCY never reaches the runtime, and @netscript/plugin-streams root exports always throw
test(e2e): the merge-readiness gate probes API health only — background children and streams go unverified, and a saga stuck compensating is reported COMPENSATED
fix(scaffold): the generated service ships `/api` unprotected and a framework test codifies public API routes as correct
fix(plugin): `createPluginService` has no auth seam, so every first-party plugin API is unguardable by construction
fix(auth): `POST /api/v1/auth/signout` revokes any session id an unauthenticated caller supplies
fix(auth): oRPC `signin`/`callback` discard the backend `Set-Cookie`, so the interactive browser flow can never establish a session
fix(service): the default CORS policy is `origin: '*'`, which makes credentialed browser calls impossible on every generated and plugin service
test(e2e): the scaffold runtime auth gate proves only that an unauthenticated request succeeds
chore(workers): eliminate 20 private-type-ref diagnostics from the published export surface
test(queue): eliminate typed-queue DLQ timing flake
docs(sdk): align cache-first loaders on action-then-metadata and document the warm-stale persistence-failure shape
fix(workers): queue dispatch path drops CORRELATION_ID/TRACEPARENT env injection for task subprocesses
fix(queue): named queues collide on a shared local Deno KV database — listeners consume each other's messages
fix(workers): documented web-worker/subprocess runner modes are unimplemented — docs truthing or Tier-3 pool implementation
fresh-ui: useDialog/useSheet never call showModal(), so every Dialog opens non-modally
docs(reference/sdk): align error-handling emphasis between the reference page and package JSDoc
docs(mcp): clear baseline private-type-ref errors across the export map
[aspire-13-5 S6b] Protocol/credential-level readiness for backing services (0.0.8 follow-up to S6)
fix(cli): Garnet executable arm binds host port 6379 regardless of Aspire allocation
docs(packages): 116 published JSDoc examples reference undeclared application-side names
fix(packages): 20 published JSDoc examples do not type-check against their documented signature
test(contracts): harden the baseContract initializer pin against identifier rebinding and annotation-span brittleness
fix(logger): LoggingPlugin correlates request IDs via shared closure state, so concurrent requests cross-attribute
fix(sagas): unresolved-endpoint rejection carries a bare `no-endpoint` reason that names none of the keys it tried
test(sagas): no coverage proves publish survives unavailable API, restart, duplicate publish, or out-of-order delivery
chore(aspire): migrate NetScript to Garnet 2.x — arms are split across 1.1.1 and 1.1.10 while 2.1.5 is current
fix(tooling): check:aspire-host-ports passes on runtime literal service URLs its own S5 test rejects
feat(plugin): validate root composition collisions and dependency closure
feat(cli): expose non-mutating plugin and Aspire generated-surface parity
fix(docs): the `@app/router.ts` README fence pair is deferred on fixture-drift risk, not impossibility
fix(sagas): .compensate() results are never persisted — an instance that compensates rests at `compensating` forever
fix(cli): --no-aspire init emits netscript.config.ts but every command reads appsettings.json, so the generated project cannot be operated
bug(auth): OpenAPI GET me rejects empty request before authentication
feat(cli): agent init misses its host, ships no OpenCode MCP config, and is never run by init — agents silently work without MCP
fix(cli): agent init mirrors the whole .agents/skills tree into .claude/skills and ships no CLAUDE.md — the repo's own pattern is a one-file bridge plus @AGENTS.md
docs/cli: renaming or moving a route is undocumented, unsupported by CLI verbs, and misdocumented as type-safe
mcp: get_doc "bounded summary" is truncation, not summarization
contract list reports 'service paired' from a directory-existence check, not from a registered handler
sdk: createServiceClient cannot resolve a service URL on React Native, and the pure resolver that would fix it is unexported
aspire generator: `register-background.mts` is emitted with unused local bindings when no background processors are configured
aspire: a generated project silently cannot reach its own provisioned containers when the Docker daemon is not local, and nothing reports it
auth-kv-oauth: assertHttps is proxy-blind while deriveHttps is proxy-aware, so the OAuth flow refuses any TLS-terminating-proxy deployment
doctor: `plugin_registry` reports a missing registry and prescribes a remedy the generator provably cannot satisfy
config: a service's port can be pinned, a plugin's cannot — and the auth plugin hosts an OAuth callback
fix(cli): generated aspire-cli.ts invokes `aspire` by bare name, so a version-managed toolchain cannot run it — and the file says DO NOT EDIT
fix(cli): `generate resource` resolves the contract from --client, not --procedure, so it cannot scaffold against a multi-namespace service
fix(sdk): createServiceClient erases the contract error map, so isDefinedError narrows to never
fix(auth): non-OIDC providers get the session id as their subject, and the plugin exposes no way to change it
fix(ai): keep published TanStack adapter ranges peer-compatible with AI core
fix(fresh/sdk): align TanStack DB adapter family; mixed Collection runtimes crash stream-query SSR
fix(fresh): route.href hides useContext and corrupts island hook order / navigation
Desktop SDK 0.0.7: window-scoped pending receive prevents client reconnection after document reload
fix(ai/anthropic): Claude 5.5 IDs rejected locally on 0.0.7; qualify forward-compatible model support
service/sdk: no documented internal (service-to-service) procedure lane; nothing provisions the credential and the OpenAPI projection is an easy bypass
service: defineService has no middleware slot and @netscript/service has no request-body size limit
plugin-workers-core: JobContext has no AbortSignal or deadline, so handlers cannot observe timeout, shutdown or cancel
fresh/ai: durable chat transcript appends carry no producer identity/epoch, so stale writers cannot be fenced
fresh/ai: createNetScriptChatConnection.send narrows UIMessages to text, blocking adoption of the #1583 single-subscriber fix
database: harden PostgreSQL command error classification and tidy #2093 docs
feat(streams): stream retention seam (create-time TTL, delete/head admin port) in plugin-streams-core
fix(kv): MemoryKvAdapter.atomic returns a versionstamp no entry has (CAS after commit always fails)
sdk: supported React Native / Expo runtime: service client, fetch-based durable stream source, live-query binding
fix(kv): RedisKvAdapter.watch holds back a received change, and a stale debounce timer drops queued ones
fix(mcp): find_guidance matches on stop words, so sentence-length intents miss the right page
database: Postgres connection-string normalizer that preserves TLS or refuses (ADO.NET/Npgsql form)
service/auth: createContractAuthorizer denies raw routes mounted under the guarded prefix; no authentication-only seam for them
service: rate-limit stage for anonymous routes, and expose the client remote address
logger: add handle/prompt to RPC debug redaction and make the fragments configurable
feat(plugins): a supported KV-only install for workers, sagas and triggers
fix(plugins): retention for the KV runtime stores of sagas, workers and triggers
feat(workers): a stdin payload channel for polyglot tasks
sdk: createQueryFactories rejects a client whose bearer contribution context is required
